## About
Tuned Autoworks is a family owned repair shop serving the West Kendall area. Our ASE certified technicians handle everything from oil changes and brakes to computer diagnostics and performance upgrades, on any make or model.
We take the time to explain every job and give you an estimate before we start. Frank and the team keep you in the loop, and drivers have rated us 4.9 from 136 Google reviews.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance: Bring your car in for its next scheduled maintenance and we'll keep it in good shape.
- Diagnostics: From simple checks to complex computer diagnostics, we track down what's wrong.
- Batteries, brakes and tune-ups: The everyday repairs that keep your car reliable and safe.
- Performance upgrades: For drivers who want more out of their car than the basics.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Request a date and time at least 48 hours ahead. Your appointment is set once one of our team follows up to confirm it.

Q: Do you work on my make and model?
A: Yes. Our ASE certified technicians work on any make or model.
